assessments.reasoning: agpl_terms [106,296) contains the FSF copyright notice and identifies the grantee, the permitted acts, the document, and the restriction on changes. Section 4's separate treatment of verbatim program source confirms the distinction.

challenge.method: Compared an unchanged copy of the publisher text, a copy with an edited clause, and distribution of a program accompanied by the unchanged license.
challenge.results: The unchanged document falls within the permission. Editing a clause defeats the verbatim condition. Accompanying a program with the license can satisfy a document-delivery requirement, while distribution of the program still depends on the applicable software provisions, including §§4–6.

limitations: This permission concerns copies of the license document. Distribution of covered software has its own conditions.
reasoning: The FSF's opening notice permits anyone to reproduce and distribute the complete AGPLv3 license document verbatim. The same notice expressly disallows changing the document.
